Transplant shock can be a challenge for certain plants, especially those that are more sensitive to environmental changes. Tomatoes, peppers, and cucumbers are examples of plants that are more prone to experiencing transplant shock compared to hardier varieties like cabbage or kale.; To minimize the risk, ensure these sensitive plants are well-hardened by gradually exposing them to outdoor conditions over a week before transplanting. …
